cases.rationale: The crop shows a real baseball player and his orange leather fielding mitt. The shirt graphics are not separate objects; no bat or other listed equipment is visible. All 75 definitions were considered; no unresolved category ambiguity.

A passenger police car fills the crop, with other cars behind it, and a complete white fire hydrant stands on the sidewalk. The small white vehicle at the upper right leaves truck versus passenger vehicle unresolved, so truck (7) is unclear. The sidewalk posts and background fixtures are not identifiable traffic signals or meters; all 75 definitions were considered.

A real black bear with pale muzzle, rounded ears, paws and claws climbs between tree trunks. The surrounding wood, rock and vegetation do not contain another listed object, and this is not a plush toy. All 75 definitions were considered; no unresolved category ambiguity.

Passengers, individual passenger seats and separate seat-back monitors are visible. The curved cabin wall and oval aircraft window identify an actual airplane cabin/fuselage part. The monitors count as TV-type standalone displays, while their displayed content does not count as actual objects. All 75 definitions were considered; no unresolved category ambiguity.

Scissors have clearly visible paired finger loops and blades. A transparent drinking tumbler holds pens, and bound books with covers and page blocks are stacked at the right of the work surface. The green writing tool has no visible toothbrush bristles, and the work surface is not a dining table. All 75 definitions were considered; no unresolved category ambiguity.

The divided food box contains identifiable peeled orange sections. The red and purple round fruit are grapes, the lower red sphere is a tomato, the green slices are cucumber, and the orange-brown sauced pieces are not identifiable carrots or frankfurters. The toasted bread and heart-shaped bread lack sandwich filling or identifiable cake structure. All 75 definitions were considered; no unresolved category ambiguity.

Two actual harnessed horses pull a carriage with a visible human driver. The carriage has an identifiable long passenger bench seat/back; its wheels and road setting do not make it a car or bicycle. The carriage decorations and distant greenery do not identify any additional listed object. All 75 definitions were considered; no unresolved category ambiguity.

The group contains actual people, and the central young man wears a necktie and holds a straight-sided drinking tumbler. There is no identifiable stem and foot to support wine glass. The cropped flowers and container at the upper right do not resolve a rooted potted plant versus cut flowers in a vase, so potted plant (58) and vase (75) are unclear. All 75 definitions were considered.

An open laptop has a visible integrated screen and keyboard, and a white computer mouse sits below it. The integrated laptop display is not a separate TV. The foreground contains envelopes, papers and an open box rather than an identifiable bound book. All 75 definitions were considered; no unresolved category ambiguity.

This crop contains a red barber-shop sign and its metal support structure. The lettering is not STOP text, and neither the sign nor its supports are a traffic signal, parking meter, chair or another listed actual object. All 75 definitions were considered; no unresolved category ambiguity.

An orange rail tram, a black-and-yellow road bus, passenger cars and people are visible in the city street. The tram is a train under the definition, with its road-running rail-vehicle body distinct from the bus behind it. Street poles and overhead wires do not identify a signal head, and no truck is identifiable. All 75 definitions were considered; no unresolved category ambiguity.

Several real skateboarders and identifiable skateboard decks/wheels are visible. A green slatted park bench with supports stands behind the central rider; the concrete skating ledges are not themselves benches. No backpack or other listed carried object is identifiable. All 75 definitions were considered; no unresolved category ambiguity.

Two ring doughnuts, one frosted, rest in paper on a kitchen counter. Behind them is a glass-front countertop conventional/toaster oven with a visible cooking rack and controls. The paper is not a book, the counter is not a dining table, and the doughnuts are distinct from plain bagels. All 75 definitions were considered; no unresolved category ambiguity.

A woman rides an actual horse on the beach, with another rider partly visible at the left. The black pack on her back has an identifiable backpack body and wearing context. Horse bodies, saddles and reins do not identify a handbag, bench or other listed object. All 75 definitions were considered; no unresolved category ambiguity.

Two people stand in a living room, one pointing a handheld remote toward a separate TV display. The football players shown on the screen are excluded as depicted content. Upholstered seating is cropped at the sides, and its single-person chair versus sofa structure is unresolved; chair (56) and couch (57) are unclear. Side tables and lamps do not establish a dining table. All 75 definitions were considered.

The ornate outdoor clock has a clearly identifiable clock face, hands and housing. Its sculpted figures and architectural ornament are not actual humans or animals. The supporting structure is not a traffic signal or parking meter. All 75 definitions were considered; no unresolved category ambiguity.

Several real zebras have striped equid bodies, and the brown horned animal at the right is cattle. The cattle head and body distinguish it from a horse or sheep; zebras are explicitly excluded from horse. The trees and grass are not potted plants. All 75 definitions were considered; no unresolved category ambiguity.

A real green bird with beak, feet and feathered body perches on a hanging cluster of actual green bananas. The banana shape and cluster attachment distinguish the fruit from generic green objects. The foliage is not in an identifiable pot, and the bird is not a toy or kite. All 75 definitions were considered; no unresolved category ambiguity.

A cropped red octagonal STOP sign has readable STO lettering and an identifiable sign face. The separate area-closed notice, fence and gate do not identify a parking meter, traffic light or bench. All 75 definitions were considered; no unresolved category ambiguity.

The room shows dining chairs and a small eating table, a patterned bed corner, a conventional cooking range/oven, a sink/tap assembly, bottles, and a knife on the green cutting board. The white countertop appliance has an indistinct door/control arrangement, leaving microwave (68) unclear despite the separate definite oven. Tiny countertop vessels do not resolve cup (41) or bowl (45), so both remain unclear. The upper-right wall appliance does not identify a refrigerator. All 75 definitions were considered.

A real person has just thrown the white flying disc near the tree. A small grey pigeon with identifiable bird body/head stands on the grass. The airborne disc is not a plate or ball, and the trees do not establish potted plants. All 75 definitions were considered; no unresolved category ambiguity.

A real person in a tennis-serving pose holds an identifiable racket handle and shaft extending through the upper edge. The court screen and fence are not a TV, netted kite or another listed object; there is no visible fielding glove. All 75 definitions were considered; no unresolved category ambiguity.

A real hand grips bound books with visible spines and covers. A separate computer keyboard with identifiable keys is visible behind them. The illustrated bird on a book cover is excluded as a depiction, and the keyboard alone does not establish an actual laptop. All 75 definitions were considered; no unresolved category ambiguity.

A real red passenger train is beside the rail platform, where a person in orange work clothing stands. The wall-mounted analog time-of-day clock has hands and numerals. Platform signs and timetable boards are not TV screens, and the orange safety clothing does not identify a backpack. All 75 definitions were considered; no unresolved category ambiguity.

People are visible at the bottom left and near the distant red-and-white beach umbrella. Small winged birds are visible against the sky. The distant seating structure beneath the umbrella is too small to establish a single-person chair, so chair (56) is unclear. Rocks and distant marks do not identify a boat or another listed object. All 75 definitions were considered.

The crop shows actual zebras, including the complete striped body and head of the foreground animal. Their stripes and equid forms identify zebra and exclude horse under the definition. The surrounding shrubs have no identifiable pots. All 75 definitions were considered; no unresolved category ambiguity.

A banana and an orange are identifiable on the fruit stand, alongside pears and red-yellow stone-fruit-like items. The red round fruit does not decisively resolve apple versus peach/nectarine at this resolution, so apple (47) is unclear. The broad flat pedestal serving plate is neither a bowl nor a wine-glass-form drinking vessel. All 75 definitions were considered.

A parking meter fills the foreground, with passenger-car bodywork visible behind it. The digital countdown belongs to the parking meter and is explicitly excluded from clock. The meter is not a hydrant, traffic light or handheld remote. All 75 definitions were considered; no unresolved category ambiguity.

A flock of actual sheep fills the road beside people and a passenger SUV/car. Woolly bodies and sheep faces identify sheep rather than cattle or goats. Road bollards are not parking meters, and no separate dog is identifiable among the flock. All 75 definitions were considered; no unresolved category ambiguity.

A real person leans back beneath a yellow flying disc, whose thin rounded form and flight context identify frisbee. It is not banana fruit, a kite or a bird. Trees and grass contain no other identifiable listed object. All 75 definitions were considered; no unresolved category ambiguity.

Identifiable narrow-neck bottles stand on the counter, a countertop conventional/toaster oven is at the left, and green bowls are stacked on the lower shelf. The large wide-mouth storage jars are not bottles or drinking cups, and the cordless landline handset in its base is not a cell phone or remote control. Plates, shelves and kitchen counter are not a dining table. All 75 definitions were considered; no unresolved category ambiguity.

A bare mattress in bed context lies on a raised base, and a single-person chair is partly visible at the lower right. The broken debris at the left has no identifiable toilet bowl, sink/tap assembly, refrigerator door or other listed appliance structure. The yellow cylinder does not show a bottle neck or recognizable drinking-vessel form. All 75 definitions were considered; no unresolved category ambiguity.

A real child holds a white game remote in front of a separate TV, with bound books visible at the lower right. The cartoon figures on the screen are excluded as depictions, and the entertainment stand is not a dining table or keyboard. The cropped green round vessel at the far left is insufficiently resolved as a bowl, so bowl (45) is unclear. All 75 definitions were considered.

The yellow fire hydrant has a clearly identifiable body, cap and outlets. A real pedestrian is visible behind it. The background street lamp is not a traffic light, and the roadside vegetation lacks pot evidence. All 75 definitions were considered; no unresolved category ambiguity.

An actual dog wears a rigid purple recovery collar. The clothed knees of the seated viewer are visible in the foreground as identifiable human legs. The collar is neither a frisbee nor a bowl, and the dog is not a stuffed toy. All 75 definitions were considered; no unresolved category ambiguity.

An actual black bear with full body, head and legs stands in a rocky enclosure. The small cropped grey form at the lower-right edge could be a human shoe/foot or part of the enclosure; person (0) is therefore unclear. It is not a teddy bear, and the fence and rocks do not identify another listed object. All 75 definitions were considered.

Several actual people in sports clothing stand and run beside a soccer goal. The net and goal frame are not a kite, tennis racket or another listed object, and no baseball fielding glove is visible. All 75 definitions were considered; no unresolved category ambiguity.

Identifiable broccoli florets accompany meat and mushrooms on a plate at an eating-table setting with other plates and chopsticks. The visible table surface is a dining table; the flat plates are not bowls. Chopsticks are not forks, knives or spoons, and the sauced meat is not an identifiable frankfurter. All 75 definitions were considered; no unresolved category ambiguity.

Two actual people are beside/on a bed with patterned bedding. The thin open computer on the reclining person is an identifiable laptop; its keyboard area is too oblique and small to resolve identifiable keys or keyboard body, so keyboard (66) is unclear. The integrated screen is not a separate TV, and the framed illustration is excluded as depicted content. All 75 definitions were considered.

Real baseball players and spectators are visible, with a fielding mitt on the pitcher's non-throwing hand and identifiable individual stadium seats. Tiny drink-like items near the dugout floor do not resolve bottle (39) versus cup (41), so both are unclear. The dugout rail is not an identifiable long bench seat, and no other listed object is established. All 75 definitions were considered.
